lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca2Tm2S4 (CaTmS2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Ca and Tm each coordinated by eight S neighbors, while S centers have nine geometric neighbors (four Ca, three Tm, two S). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ca–Tm polyhedra, plus corner and edge sharing among like Ca and like Tm polyhedra.
